content: Shuccunata yanapanami balin

Chita yuyarisha mana ñucanchillata yuyarisha causanachu. Astahuan ñucanchi sinzhi quiriccunaga chi mana sinzhi quiriccunata yanapana manchi. Llashacta aparisha yanapashcacuinta paiguna Jesucristohuan ali puringahua yanapashunchi.
Ñáucanchi caran shuc, chi shuc quiric huauquita alita rashcahuan yanapana manchi paihuas sinzhi quiric tucungahua.
Jesucristoga chasnallata mana pai amullataga yuyarishcachu. Chimanda Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami tiyan:

content.text: Canda piñasha jiridsata rimaccunaga ñucatahuas chillatatami rimahuaunguna, nishcami.

content: Tucui chi Diospa shimibi ñaupa quillcashcagunaga ñucanchita yachachingahua quillcashcami. Chi shimiga ñucanchi mana saquina yuyaita, ahuantana yuyaitas cunmi. Chasnallata chi shimita yuyarisha Dios alita rangaraushcata chapaunchimi.
Canguna Señor Jesucristo yuyarishcacuinta causashcamanda mana saquina yuyaita cuc ahuantachic Dios cangunata yanapachun cangunapura shuc yuyaillahuan causangahua.
Canguna chasna shuc yuyaillahuan causashaga tucui pariu shuc shimillahuancuinta ñucanchi Señor Jesucristohua Yaya Diosta balichinguichimi.
Chasna acpi Cristo cangunata ailluyachishcacuinta cangunapura chasnallata pariumanda aillucuinta tucuichi runaguna Diosta ali man nisha rimangahua.
Mana-israelguna Diospa quishpina shimita uyashcamanda

Casnami nini, Dios unai ñaupa uras ñucanchi huañuc apayayagunama rimashcami shuc quishpichicta cachashami nisha. Huasha, Cristo shamusha israelgunata yanapangahua shamura, paigunama Dios sirtu rimashcata ricuchingahua,
chasnallata chi mana-israelgunatahuas Dios llaquisha quishpichishcamanda paita balichinata ushanaun. Chi mana-israelgunamanda Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami:

content.text: Dios yapa ali man nisha rimashami,
camba shutita alabasha cantashami, nishami nin.

content: Shucpihuas Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami:
Chasnallata shucpi casna mandasha quillcashcami:
Chasnallata huañuc Isaiasca quishpichic Cristomanda casnami quillcashca:

content.text: Mandac rey amu Davidba yaya Isaí nishcamanda
mirai runa shamusha mandac rey amu tucunga.

content: Chapana yuyaita cuc Diosllata canguna paita quirishcamanda cangunata ashca cushita cuchun, mana manzhana ganas causaita cuchun. Pai cangunata chasna rachun paihua Samai ushaihuan canguna Cristota chapana yuyaita mas charingahua nisha mañani.
Sinzhi quiriccunama quillcani
Ñáucallata canguna yapa ali ashcata yachanimi quiric huauquiguna. Cangunallata ashcata yachashami pariumanda yachachinacunata ushanguichimi.
Chasna agllaita mana imatas manzhasha rimashcani canguna yachashcata cuti yuyaringahua. Dios ñucata llaquisha japihuarami casna yachachingahua.

Chimandami Jesucristohuacta rani Diospa quishpina shimita mana-israel runagunama camachini. Chasna rani chi uyaccuna Dios japinalla cumbiranacuinta anauchun nisha Diospa Samai paigunata Dioshuan alichishcamanda.
Chasna acpi Jesucristohuan shuglla ashami Yaya Diospacta rausha yapa cushiyani.
Chasna asha Cristo tucui ñucata yanapashcata rimashami. Pai chasna yanapacpimi ashca mana-israel runaguna ñuca camachishcata uyasha, ushaihuan rashcagunatas ricusha Diosta uyangahua callarishcaunami.

Chasna Diospa Samai ushaihuan ñuca rashcagunata ricusha quirinaura. Jerusalen llactamanda callarisha tucui llactagunaibi camachisha caruibi tiyac Ilírico nishca llactagama pactasha Jesucristo quishpichinamanda pactacta yachachishcanimi.

Chasna yachachingahua purisha, shuccuna ña yachachishcaibi ñuca chibi yachachinata mana munaranichu, astahuanbas Jesucristomanda mana uyashca llactagunaibi pai quishpichic man nishca shimimanda yachachinata yapa munashcani.
Chimanda Diospa shimibi casna quillcashcami:

content.text: Chara paimanda mana yachachishca runaguna paita ricungaunami,
chara mana uyac runaguna paihua shimita intindingaunami ninmi.

content: Pablo Roma llactama rinata yuyarin
Chasna maimas yachachisha puriusha cunan urascama cangunama shamunata munashallata ashca cutin jarcashca arani, chiraicu mana pactamunata ushashcanichu.
Astahuan cunanga cai llactagunaibi camachinata ña tucuchishcanimi. Unaimanda cunangama cangunama shamunata munashcanimi.
Chimanda España llactama riusha cangunahuacpi pasianata munani. Cangunahuacpi cushihuan tiyashcahuasha ñuca Españama ringahua ima minishtishcata canguna yanapahuanauchun nisha munani.
Astahuanbas cunanga cangunama mana shamushallata Jerusalenma ñaupata riuni tandashca cullquita chibi tiyac quiriccunata yanapangahua.
Chi Jerusalenbi tiyac pugri quiriccunata yanapashun nisha Macedonia, Acaya llactagunamanda quiriccuna cullquita tandasha cachanatas munanaura.

Paigunallatami cullquita chasna cunatas munanaura. Sirtumi paigunama yanapana manaura. Israel runaguna Diospa shimita yachachishcamandami mana-israelgunaga quirisha Diospa runaguna tucushcauna. Chimanda dihuiyuccuinta ashami cunanga minishtishca israelgunata yanapana anaun.
Chi cullquita apasha paigunahuan tucuita saquishcahuasha Españama risha nini. Chima riusha cangunahuacpi pasianata munani.
Chasna cangunahuagma pactashcai Cristo ali yanapanata pactata cuhuangaraun cangunata yachachingahua.

Uyaichi huauquiguna, canguna ñucahuan pariu sinzhita mañasha ñucata yanapahuanguichimi. Cunanga ñucanchi Señor Jesucristota quirishcaraigu, Diospa Samai pariumanda llaquinacuna yuyaita cushcaraicu, ñucamanda Diosta sinzhita rugapaichi nini.
Chi Jerusalenbi tiyac quiriccuna ñuca apashca cullquita cushihuan japinauchun, chasnallata chibi tiyac mana-quiriccuna ama imatas ñucata rahuanauchun nisha Diosta rugapaichi.
Chasna Jerusalenbi pasiashca ali tucucpi chimanda Dios munacpi cangunama cushihuan shamunata ushanimi. Chibi cangunahuan pariu tiyasha cushihuan samanata ushani.
Cushi causaita cuc Dios cangunahuan tiyachun nisha paita mañasha tapuni. Chasna achun.
